CLICKSEND_CREATE_AUTOMATIONS_SMS_INBOUND.description: Tool to create a new inbound SMS automation rule in ClickSend. Use when you need to set up automated actions to trigger when inbound SMS messages are received.

action.description: Action to perform when rule matches. Valid values: AUTO_REPLY, EMAIL_USER, EMAIL_FIXED, URL, SMS, POLL, GROUP_SMS, MOVE_CONTACT, CREATE_CONTACT, CREATE_CONTACT_PLUS_EMAIL, CREATE_CONTACT_PLUS_NAME_EMAIL, CREATE_CONTACT_PLUS_NAME, SMPP, NONE.

enabled.description: Controls activation status of the rule. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled.

rule_name.description: Name of the automation rule to identify it. Helps organize and manage multiple rules.

webhook_type.description: Webhook format type. Valid values: 'post', 'get', or 'json'. Defaults to 'post' if not specified.

action_address.description: Target destination for the specified action. For EMAIL_FIXED provide email address, for URL provide webhook URL, for contact lists provide list ID.

dedicated_number.description: The dedicated phone number to apply this rule to. Use '*' to apply the rule to all numbers.

message_search_term.description: Text pattern to match against incoming messages. Can be null for message_search_type=0 (any message).

message_search_type.description: Message matching logic. 0 = Any message, 1 = starts with, 2 = contains, 3 = does not contain.

SAPERLY_CREATE_CONNECTION.description: Create a connection: the AI 'brain' that answers calls and (optionally) SMS on a Saperly phone number. A phone number binds to a connection via SAPERLY_ASSIGN_NUMBER_CONNECTION in order to answer calls. Only `name` is required. mode 'hosted' (default) = an in-network STT->LLM->TTS voice assistant driven by `instructions` (the system prompt), `tts` voice (voiceId from SAPERLY_LIST_VOICES), and `language`; mode 'manual' = your own webhook brain (set `manualWebhookUrl`). complianceEnabled defaults true — Saperly then speaks a TCPA `disclosure` as the first uninterruptible utterance, auto-filling a standard org-named disclosure if you leave it empty. Returns the created connection (201). Free. (The 'backend' field is intentionally not exposed: only 'network' works; 'openai_realtime' is server-rejected.)

kind.description: Always 'managed' — the hosted assistant runs the model in-network.

model.description: The in-network managed model the hosted assistant runs.

llm.description: Model override for the hosted assistant.

voiceId.description: The voice the hosted assistant speaks with. Use an `id` returned by SAPERLY_LIST_VOICES (optionally filtered by language). Hosted mode only.

provider.description: Text-to-speech provider. Omit to use the in-network default provider.

mode.description: How the line is handled. 'hosted' (default): an in-network voice assistant (STT -> LLM -> TTS) is the brain, driven by `instructions`, `tts`, and `language`. 'manual': your own webhook brain is the brain (set `manualWebhookUrl`).

language.description: Spoken language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'en-US'), used as the transcription hint. See SAPERLY_LIST_LANGUAGES. Send '' to clear (auto-detect).

disclosure.description: TCPA notice spoken first (uninterruptibly) when `complianceEnabled` is on. Leave empty to let Saperly auto-fill a standard org-named default.

url.description: Public https:// URL of your streamable-HTTP MCP server (commonly ending in `/mcp`). SSE-only servers are not supported.

type.description: Auth scheme for the MCP server: 'bearer' or 'none'.

token.description: Bearer token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to your server. Required when `type` is 'bearer'; stored encrypted and never returned.

auth.description: How Saperly authenticates to your MCP server.

allowedTools.description: Allow-list of tool names to expose. Omit to expose every tool the server advertises.

items.description: A Model Context Protocol server the hosted assistant may call as tools.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers the hosted assistant may call as tools during a conversation. Hosted mode only.

endCall.description: Allow the brain to hang up the call. Defaults on.

sendDtmf.description: Allow the brain to send DTMF (touch-tone) digits. Defaults on.

targets.description: Allowed blind-transfer destinations (E.164 numbers or `sip:` URIs). Transfer only takes effect with at least one target; send an empty list to keep transfer disabled.

from_number.description: Optional E.164 caller ID to present on the transferred leg.

transfer.description: Blind-transfer enablement and its allowed targets.

callControl.description: Which call-control actions the connection's brain may take.

instructions.description: System prompt defining the assistant's behavior and opening line (there is no separate greeting field). Hosted mode.

smsAutoReply.description: Hosted-line opt-in to auto-answer inbound SMS with the model. Defaults off.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. Reusing the same key with an identical body safely replays the creation instead of creating a second connection.

manualWebhookUrl.description: HTTPS manual-mode webhook-brain URL where Saperly POSTs each turn. Only for mode='manual'.

complianceEnabled.description: When true (default), the do-not-message tool is exposed and `disclosure` is spoken first (an uninterruptible TCPA notice).

SAPERLY_ASSIGN_NUMBER_CONNECTION.description: Attach a connection (the AI persona / answering brain from SAPERLY_CREATE_CONNECTION) to a phone number, so inbound calls and SMS to that number — and outbound calls placed from it — are handled by that connection. A number without a bound connection cannot answer calls (and PLACE_CALL fails with 422 NumberHasNoConnection), so this is the wiring step that makes a number answerable. Get a connection id from SAPERLY_LIST_CONNECTIONS or create one with SAPERLY_CREATE_CONNECTION. Returns the updated number object. Free.

id.description: The phone number's id (a UUID) to bind, as returned by SAPERLY_LIST_NUMBERS or SAPERLY_GET_NUMBER.

connectionId.description: The connection id (a UUID) to bind as this number's answering brain. A connection is an agent persona / call handler that decides how inbound calls and SMS to this number are handled. Obtain one from SAPERLY_LIST_CONNECTIONS or create a new one with SAPERLY_CREATE_CONNECTION.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. Reusing the same key with an identical body safely replays the assignment instead of applying it twice.
